data.one_liner: A Dart package for building interactive console applications with widgets, input handling, and progress indicators.
data.what_it_does: Capp provides a set of console widgets such as tables, progress bars, spinners, and input prompts. It also manages command-line arguments, options, and automatic help generation, allowing developers to create rich CLI tools in Dart.
use_when: Need to build a command-line tool with interactive prompts
Want built-in progress indicators and table output
Require automatic help generation for commands
Need to capture or hook into console output for logging or testing
avoid_when: Building a GUI or web application
Working in environments without a terminal
strengths: Rich set of console widgets out of the box
Support for capturing console output via hooks
weaknesses: Not a state-management or networking library
data.setup_notes: Add "capp: ^2.3.2" to pubspec and import package:capp/capp.dart

alternatives.why_pick_it: For parsing YAML configuration files, not a direct replacement for console widgets
